name: app-oviah-iconography-set-outline-icons-on-grey-panel
title: OVIAH iconography sheet: a full set of thin outline icons for health tracking on a grey rounded panel
whatItIs: A grey rounded panel holding roughly 50 thin-stroke outline icons in three rows, covering navigation (link, moon, calendar), health symbols (droplet, heart, no-symbol), actions (edit, lock, search), and body/lifestyle icons (person, food, exercise), all in one consistent line weight.
whatItMeans: Cohesive and legible; one uniform stroke weight across so many icons keeps a dense health app visually calm.
techniques: Draw every icon at the same stroke weight and corner radius.
Group icons loosely by function within one sheet.
Present the whole set on a single neutral panel for review.

vocabulary.definition: A collection of icons sharing one visual style.
The thickness of an icon's outline.
